egress.terms: 'Download volume: Unlimited' on the free row; direct fs430.uploadhive.com/cgi-bin/dl.cgi/<key>/<name> links

tooling: XFileSharing Pro family (sibsoft.net/xfilesharing.html) — same shape as ~hundreds of hosts, so one client works across all of them; discovery is GET /server -> {"url":"https://fs430.uploadhive.com/cgi-bin"} then POST upload.cgi with utype=anon; also used by PolyUploader (github.com/spel987/PolyUploader)
chaining: 3 layers: (a) files per host carry no stated limit, (b) 50-day retention resets on download so a periodic re-fetch keeps data alive indefinitely, (c) the whole XFileSharing family is the multiplier — each host takes one free registration with its own 100s-of-GB-to-2TB pool (see UpZur/FileAxa/Mega4up entries)
limits_note: unlimited per file; 50 days after last download for free; no API key needed for anonymous upload

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: r FAQ (direct dl.cgi links resolved but were IP-gated); no API key needed for anonymous upload anonymous-dump

reliability_note: dl.cgi returned 'Wrong IP' on every download attempt regardless of referer/cookies — downloads appear bound to the uploading IP, so a distributed fetch layer needs matching egress IPs
